Full guide for applicants

VIFC Member Registration and Recognition Portal · member.vifc.gov.vn

Version 2 · 25 Nov 2026 · replaces version 1 of 16 Nov 2026

Before you start

This guide is for people who use an enterprise account to fill in, send and follow a member registration dossier on the portal member.vifc.gov.vn.

Each task has a purpose, ordered steps, screenshots with numbered orange frames matching the steps, and a Done when line so you know you are finished. Button and menu names are in bold.

Screenshots were taken on a test dossier; figures shown are sample data. Chaptered clips for each task are at guideline.vifc.gov.vn, under Applicant.

Dossier journey

StageWho holds itWhat the applicant sees
1. SubmitApplicantThe TIẾN ĐỘ PHÊ DUYỆT (approval progress) panel appears at the top; Thu hồi withdraws the dossier.
2. ReceptionOne-stop deskThe Kiểm tra hồ sơ step is waiting (yellow). If a supplement is requested, the dossier returns under Yêu cầu đã nhận.
3. AppraisalMember Department officer in charge; Legal Department gives its opinionThe status line reads Đã phê duyệt. No further action is needed from the applicant.
4. DecisionOfficer submits; head, deputy head and the Presidium approveNothing changes on the applicant side yet.
5. CertificateMember Department officer; the Presidium approvesThe certificate notice arrives under Yêu cầu đã nhận.
6. CompletedMember Department officer changes the statusThe enterprise is listed at member.vifc.gov.vn/member-information.

Dossier statuses

StatusMeaningWhat next
Đang lưuDraft, not sent.Editable. Reopen under Yêu cầu của tôi - Đang lưu.
Chờ phê duyệtSent and waiting at a step of the Operating Authority.Not editable; can be withdrawn with Thu hồi.
Yêu cầu bổ sungReturned for supplement.Editable. Open under Yêu cầu đã nhận, fix, Lưu then Gửi.
Đã bổ sungResubmitted after the supplement.Not editable.
Đã phê duyệtConfirmed complete; the Authority appraises, decides and issues the certificate.No action needed.
Từ chốiThe dossier was rejected.Read the reason in the dossier; submit a new one if needed.

Getting started

Log in

HD.DN.16

Enter the portal with the account you were given.

  1. Open member.vifc.gov.vn. The Login page appears.
  2. Enter your Email or username and Password. Both fields are required.
  3. Tick Remember login on your own computer; leave it unticked on a shared one.
  4. Click Login.

Done when the Homepage appears.

If you see: Forgot your password - The login page has no password-reset button. Open Contact on the top bar and ask the Executive Agency to reset it.

If you see: Switch language before logging in - Click the flag icon at the top right and choose Tiếng Việt or English.

Homepage, notifications, switching language

HD.DN.02

Know the menu items, where notifications appear and how to switch the display language.

  1. After signing in you land on the Homepage. The left menu has these items: Homepage, Create dossier, Dossier management, Received requests, My requests, Check company name.
  2. Four counters show dossiers that are Processing, Following, Remind, Late. Click View details on a counter to open its list.
  3. Click the bell icon at the top right to open Notifications, with two tabs: All and Unread.
  4. Click the flag icon and choose Tiếng Việt or English to switch language.
  5. The Documents & Guidelines box on the right holds the Member registration guide, Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) and Support contact.

Done when you can open Notifications and switch the display language.

One working cycle for an applicant

HD.DN.03

See the whole cycle, from preparation to tracking, before you start.

  1. Prepare: check the planned company name under Check company name.
  2. Build the dossier: open Create dossier, choose the procedure, fill in the 12 sections and attach documents.
  3. Review and submit: click Check dossier, then Send. If you are not finished, click Save to keep a draft.
  4. Track: follow the dossier on the Homepage, in Dossier management and in My requests; items waiting for you are in Received requests.

Done when you know which menu item each task lives under.

Preparation

Check company name

HD.DN.04

Find out whether the planned company name is already registered before you fill in the form.

  1. Open Check company name in the menu.
  2. Enter the Planned Vietnamese Name (required). You may also enter an Abbreviated Name and a Foreign Name.
  3. Click Check company name. The system queries the National Business Registration Database directly.
  4. To check another name, click Reset and enter it again.

Done when the screen returns the lookup result for the name you entered.

Building the dossier

Choose the right procedure and receiving branch

HD.DN.06

Open the form of the right procedure and choose where the dossier is received.

  1. Open Create dossier. The Create request page groups procedures into three: Application for membership registration, Commodities & Clearing Exchange, Bank.
  2. Click the card of your procedure. If you cannot see it, type its name in the Search box at the top right.
  3. In the form, open section 2. Receiving branch and select the Receiving branch.

Done when the form of the right procedure is open and the Receiving branch field has a value.

If you see: You cannot find your procedure - Look in all three groups on the Create request page, or type its name in the Search box.

Fill in the form

HD.DN.07

Complete every section of the form correctly.

  1. The form is made of numbered sections listed on the left, covered in 17 steps. Work through them from section 1.
  2. Click Next to move on and the previous-step button to go back.
  3. Fields marked * are required. A completed section shows a green tick in the list on the left.

Done when every section in the left list shows a green tick.

If you see: Business line code: mine is not in the list. - Scroll to the end of the list, choose "No Business line Code Yet" and type the business line.

If you see: I have no information for some fields. - Only fields with a red * are required. Others may be left empty.

If you see: A table in the form is flagged red and I cannot continue. - Click the red text to jump to that table, then press the save button at the right of each row before the top Lưu.

If you see: Which address goes in the address field? - The enterprise's own address, not the Operating Authority's.

Download forms and attach documents

HD.DN.08

Download the forms for signing and put every document under the right item.

  1. In section 12. Confirmation & Submission, tick the declaration, then download the forms under Download Registration Forms for signing.
  2. Scroll down to Documents. For each item, click Add files and choose the file.
  3. Items marked * are required. "Required documents attached: …/12" shows how many are still missing.

Done when the counter shows all required items attached, for example 12/12.

If you see: Clicking Send shows an attachment error - A required item has no file yet. Check the counter and add files to the items marked *.

If you see: I uploaded files but they were gone when I came back. - After uploading you must press Lưu in the top bar for the files to be stored.

If you see: Which file types are accepted? Images or zip? - Scanned items take PDF; soft-copy items take Word so data can be extracted accurately. Images and archives are not accepted; export photos to PDF.

Save a draft and reopen it

HD.DN.09

Keep what you have entered and continue later.

  1. In the form, click Save at the bottom of the page.
  2. When you return, open My requests and choose the Draft tab.
  3. Click the dossier row to open it and continue.

Done when the dossier appears under the Draft tab of My requests.

If you see: I uploaded files but they were gone when I came back. - After uploading you must press Lưu in the top bar for the files to be stored.

Review and submit

Pre-submission checklist

HD.DN.10

Review the dossier so it is not returned for omissions.

  1. Right procedure: the form title at the top matches the procedure you need.
  2. Right recipient: the Receiving branch field in section 2 is selected.
  3. Complete information: every section on the left shows a green tick.
  4. Declaration made: the declaration box in section 12 is ticked.
  5. All documents: "Required documents attached: …/12" shows the full count.
  6. Click Check dossier so the system reviews the dossier before you send it.

Done when all six points above are met.

If you see: Kiểm tra hồ sơ or Gửi reports a company-name check error. - Click again. This step calls an external name lookup service that is sometimes slow.

Submit the dossier

HD.DN.11

Send the completed dossier to the Executive Agency.

  1. Go through the Pre-submission checklist card.
  2. Click Send at the bottom of the form.
  3. Go to the Homepage and find the dossier in the Request list.

Done when the dossier appears in the Request list on the Homepage, with a request code and a status.

If you see: Clicking Send shows an attachment error - A required document is missing. Add files to the items marked * and send again.

If you see: Kiểm tra hồ sơ or Gửi reports a company-name check error. - Click again. This step calls an external name lookup service that is sometimes slow.

Tracking

Track dossier status

HD.DN.12

Know where the dossier stands and whether anything is waiting for you.

  1. On the Homepage, look at the four counters and the Request list; the Status column shows where each dossier stands.
  2. Open Dossier management to see four groups: Total, Processing, Completed, Rejected. Click a counter to filter the list.
  3. Open My requests to see the dossiers you created, under All, Processing, Finished, Draft.
  4. Open Received requests to see items the Executive Agency has sent to you.

Done when you can find your dossier and read its status.

After submitting: follow the progress

HD.DN.13

Know which step your submitted dossier has reached.

  1. When you click Gửi (Send), the Thông tin phê duyệt dialog lists the steps the dossier will pass through: applicant, one-stop desk, dossier check. Add a note if needed and click Gửi in the dialog.
  2. After sending, the TIẾN ĐỘ PHÊ DUYỆT panel appears at the top of the dossier. Finished steps show a green tick, the waiting step is yellow; the Trạng thái line below gives the current status.
  3. The Thu hồi button at the right withdraws a dossier you have sent.
  4. To come back later, open My requests and click the dossier row.

Done when you can read the dossier's current step in the progress panel.

Supplement the dossier when asked

HD.DN.14

Correct and resend the dossier when the Executive Agency asks for more.

  1. Open Received requests in the left bar. A dossier returned for a supplement is listed here.
  2. Click the dossier row to open it.
  3. In the TIẾN ĐỘ PHÊ DUYỆT panel, the VIFC step reads Yêu cầu bổ sung (supplement requested) and the next step, under your name, is waiting.
  4. Correct the relevant sections, replace or add attachments as requested, then click Lưu (Save).
  5. Click Gửi (Send) to resend the dossier.

Done when your step reads Đã bổ sung and the dossier is back at the VIFC dossier-check step.

Receive the result

HD.DN.15

Know when the dossier is accepted and where the certificate notice arrives.

  1. Open My requests and click the dossier row.
  2. Once the dossier is confirmed complete, the VIFC dossier-check step reads Phê duyệt (approved).
  3. The Trạng thái line changes to Đã phê duyệt. From here the Executive Agency appraises, decides and issues the certificate; nothing more is needed from you.
  4. When the result is ready, the certificate notice is sent to Received requests. Open it and click the notice row to read it.

Done when you can open the certificate notice under Received requests.

Account

Change password, log out

HD.DN.01

Change your password and leave the portal when you are done.

  1. Click the account icon at the top right.
  2. Choose Change password to set a new password.
  3. Choose Log out when you finish, especially on a shared computer.

Done when you can sign in again with the new password.

Reference

Questions and common errors

QuestionAnswer
Business line code: mine is not in the list.Scroll to the end of the list, choose "No Business line Code Yet" and type the business line. (HD.DN.07)
I have no information for some fields.Only fields with a red * are required. Others may be left empty. (HD.DN.07)
A table in the form is flagged red and I cannot continue.Click the red text to jump to that table, then press the save button at the right of each row before the top Lưu. (HD.DN.07)
I uploaded files but they were gone when I came back.After uploading you must press Lưu in the top bar for the files to be stored. (HD.DN.08, HD.DN.09)
Which file types are accepted? Images or zip?Scanned items take PDF; soft-copy items take Word so data can be extracted accurately. Images and archives are not accepted; export photos to PDF. (HD.DN.08)
Clicking Gửi shows "Mục đính kèm không chính xác".A required document item has no file. Check the counter in the attachments section and fill the items marked *. (HD.DN.08, HD.DN.11)
Kiểm tra hồ sơ or Gửi reports a company-name check error.Click again. This step calls an external name lookup service that is sometimes slow. (HD.DN.10, HD.DN.11)
Which address goes in the address field?The enterprise's own address, not the Operating Authority's. (HD.DN.07)
I have sent it. How do I know it worked?The TIẾN ĐỘ PHÊ DUYỆT panel appears at the top; the dossier is under Yêu cầu của tôi, tab Đang xử lý. (HD.DN.13, HD.DN.12)
I forgot my password.The sign-in page has no reset button. Use Liên hệ in the top bar to ask the Operating Authority for a new one. (HD.DN.16)
A supplement was requested. Where do I fix the dossier?Open Yêu cầu đã nhận, click the dossier, fix the content and documents, press Lưu then Gửi. (HD.DN.14)
Where do I receive the result and the certificate?The certificate notice arrives under Yêu cầu đã nhận. The enterprise is also listed on the Member Information page. (HD.DN.15)

Glossary

Term (Vietnamese)EnglishMeaning
Thành viênMemberAn organisation recognised by the Operating Authority as a Member of the International Financial Centre.
Người nộp hồ sơApplicantThe person using the enterprise account to fill in and send a dossier on the portal.
Cơ quan điều hànhOperating AuthorityThe body that receives, appraises and decides on member registration dossiers.
Cơ quan tiếp nhậnReceiving officeWhere the dossier is filed, chosen when creating it (Ho Chi Minh City or Da Nang).
CổngPortalmember.vifc.gov.vn, where applicants work.
Bộ phận một cửaOne-stop deskThe first officer step: checks a new dossier, confirms it or requests a supplement.
Yêu cầu của tôiMy requestsPortal menu listing dossiers the applicant created.
Yêu cầu đã nhậnReceived requestsPortal menu holding items sent to the applicant: supplement requests, certificate notice.
TIẾN ĐỘ PHÊ DUYỆTApproval progressPanel at the top of a dossier on the portal showing the current step.
Thông tin Thành viênMember InformationPublic page listing members: member.vifc.gov.vn/member-information.

Contact

Use Liên hệ (contact) in the top bar of member.vifc.gov.vn to send a question to the Operating Authority. Send feedback on this guide to the Technology Department - Operating Authority of the International Financial Centre in Ho Chi Minh City.
